يتعادل (form VI)
# يَتَعَادَلُ (yataʕādalu) /ja.ta.ʕaː.da.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# يَتَعَادَلَ (yataʕādala) /ja.ta.ʕaː.da.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# يَتَعَادَلْ (yataʕādal) /ja.ta.ʕaː.dal/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
